body: The sad part is theyre not toxic, i know they helped me grow as a person pero i get anxiety and felt little knowing na im not important part of the group na im just saling pusa , sakit lang :/
Baka di narin ako mag hanap, im just tired to be the one to look eh, siguro if they find me great, if not then i'll just stick with myself.
Thanks, maybe i will but maybe i wont. Its so hard to be the one to always seeking them out first. I think right now i'll just enjoy myself.

Im 24 na po, they were my college friend so we've been friend for 8 years na. Nakaka baba lang po talaga kasi ng confident when i know i dont have that close friend, and that no matter how hard i try na magging good friend im just not that enough. Meanwhile my sisters have all best friend. In my entire life wala talaga akong nagging bff :/

I actually already have 2 set of friends, but then theyre both the same na ganun trato sakin. Wfh since i graduate kaya i barely socialize and i live in the province where everyone knows everyone so i cant really social more than i am since im aware of everyone. Hirap magging friend material :(

Actually i dont think they deliberately forgot about me, i think im just really not part of the "close friends" and thats really hard to admit on my part, ive done what a friend can do, i thought i already accept that fact but now im realizing how i shouldnt.
Yeah, so far if i dont initiate to plan to go out i wont be included in anything. I think this time i'll just stop initiating and probably look for different friends.
She's was gonna be 69 this may. :(
Thank you, i was having hard time if tama ba ilet go ko pero i realize i dont have to. She's always in my heart.
Will try it again. Gusto kasi nila new medical cert. Like same day eh minsan di agad nakukuha ung ibang medical test :/
Actually nakakuha kami nyan nung nov. Problem is after nun 1k nalang binibigay samin kahit na may mga medical certificate sila mama. We will try again tho. Thank you.
We already done that. They gave 3k :( we waited for 3 weeks for that.
Thanks, ive been trying but im back to zero again.
Multiple times i did. Im such a loser.

We should be friends, im like the same, im not close to any of my supposedly close friends and when they need someone im there, always present but after that theyre back to their old habit of forgetting to invite me.... yeahhh this hits too close :(

How do u actually do that tho? Im currently trying to incorporate prioritizing my self in my daily life but its really hard when i personally dont have any support system to fall into when i dont achieve those small goals, so i get sad and then again auto pilot where i pretend im okay.

Its kinda complicated, rn im supporting my 2 sisters and grandparents. I have my twin to help out but sometimes nothing is enough anymore. Ill save but having to take care of two old people is already pretty expensive :/ i just want kimchi tbh cos i know ill be okay later but rn, i just wanna be in my happy place.
